name: Softbound
thesis: A small, softly bound volume for a finite sitting, with friendly Fraunces type and confident native controls.
difference: A cream folio floats on a warm grey cover, with a quiet rose binding seam and two visible page edges; centered Fraunces headlines, inset photographs, plum reading buttons and a separate compact three-way navigation capsule keep the story at the center.
tradeoff: The folio and generous margins give each story a physical presence, but leave less room for long summaries on small phones and make the screen more enclosed than an open canvas.
lens: A contemporary bookbinder collaborating with a mobile interaction designer.
